techniques.name: Enkelt kipning
techniques.rule: Udspillet går mod honnøren, ikke fra den.
techniques.image: Indbrudstyven, der lister ind bag vagten

en.name: Single finesse
en.rule: The lead goes towards the honour, not away from it.
en.image: The burglar sneaking in behind the guard

techniques.name: Toppe eller kipning
techniques.rule: Med 8 kort tages kipningen, med 9 toppes farven.
techniques.image: Vægten: 8 vipper mod kipningen, 9 mod at toppe farven

en.name: Drop or finesse
en.rule: With 8 cards finesse, with 9 play for the drop.
en.image: The scales: 8 tips towards the finesse, 9 towards the drop

techniques.name: Spil mod honnør
techniques.rule: Udspillet går mod det kort, der skal blive stik.

en.name: Lead towards an honour
en.rule: The lead goes towards the card that is to become a trick.
en.image: The ladder up to the honour

techniques.name: Dobbelt kipning
techniques.rule: Den første kipning går mod det laveste hul.
techniques.image: To låger, hvor den nederste åbnes først

en.name: Double finesse
en.rule: The first finesse goes against the lower gap.
en.image: Two gates, the lower one opened first

techniques.name: Begrænset valg
techniques.rule: Lagde de en honnør, havde de nok ikke valget – så tages kipningen.
techniques.image: Gæsten, der kun havde én stol at vælge

en.name: Restricted choice
en.rule: If they dropped an honour, they probably had no choice – finesse.
en.image: The guest who had only one chair to choose
